user.title: Set up HouseParty
user.description: Name this alarm and create the first user. Codes are 6 to 12 digits.

data.disarm_after_trigger: Disarm when the alarm time ends (instead of re-arming)

sensors.title: Sensors
sensors.description: Choose which sensors protect each mode. A sensor that isn't closed blocks arming, unless allowed below.

data.always_on_sensors: Always-on sensors (tamper, smoke, water: trigger even when disarmed)

data.allow_open_sensors: May be open when arming (e.g. motion)
data.no_exit_delay_sensors: Trigger during the exit delay (not on your way out)
data.trigger_unavailable_sensors: Trigger if the sensor goes offline while armed

add_user.title: Add a user
add_user.description: Each code must be unique. A duress code disarms normally but fires a houseparty_duress event your automations can act on.

error.code_in_use: Another user already has this code.
error.user_limit: HouseParty supports at most 10 users per alarm.
error.last_disarmer: At least one non-duress user must be able to disarm.

auth_unavailable.message: Alarm codes are unavailable. Repair the HouseParty user store before operating the alarm.

locked_out.message: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds}s.

not_allowed.message: This code isn't allowed to do that.

invalid_state.message: The alarm can't do that right now.

arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm a HouseParty alarm, optionally force-arming past open sensors.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: away, home, night, vacation or custom.

force.name: Force
force.description: Arm even if sensors are open, bypassing them until disarmed.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: The sensors you approve bypassing. If anything else is open, arming is refused.
